The `no-self-approve.py` hook also blocks this. Even with Thảo's sign-off passed along, the edit and commit have to come from Thảo or another person on the team.

`spec/2026-10-19-han-chot-cho-viec.md:3` currently reads `Status: draft · Risk: high`. To accept it, Thảo (or you, for Thảo) should:

1. In line 3, change `Status: draft` to `Status: accepted`.
2. Run `git add spec/2026-10-19-han-chot-cho-viec.md`
3. Run `git commit -m "spec han-chot-cho-viec: accepted (Thảo)"`

The working tree already has uncommitted changes to `.claude/settings.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, `scripts/check.sh` and a few other files. Stage only the spec file so those changes don't go into this commit.

Thảo may want the spec rechecked against policy-ux v2 first, for example with the `spec-reviewer` agent. It's also rated **Risk: high** because it changes the shape of stored data.
